name: Franz Ferdinand

whyMatters.en: Glasgow four-piece whose Franz Ferdinand (2004) put angular post-punk riffing and disco bass on UK/US indie charts; Take Me Out’s mid-song tempo switch is a production textbook.
whyMatters.zh: 格拉斯哥四人组：Franz Ferdinand（2004）把棱角后朋 riff 与迪斯科贝斯送上英美 indie 榜；Take Me Out 曲中变速是制作教材。

lyricQuotes: I say don't you know / You say you don't know / I say take me out
Do you want to / Come on to me well do you want to

shortBio.en: Glasgow post-punk revival; Take Me Out is the tempo-switch single.
shortBio.zh: 格拉斯哥后朋复兴；Take Me Out 是变速单曲。

body.en:
Formed 2002 in Glasgow. Debut Franz Ferdinand (2004) and You Could Have It So Much Better (2005) pair Kapranos’s dry vocal with McCarthy’s choppy rhythm guitar, Hardy’s melodic bass, and Thomson’s tight hi-hat work.

Take Me Out (2004) splits verse and chorus tempos on purpose—dance-floor post-punk without prog length. They sit beside Interpol and The Strokes on the 2000s revival map but aim at movement and disco bass figures more than NYC garage cool.
body.zh:
2002 年于格拉斯哥组建。首专 Franz Ferdinand（2004）与 You Could Have It So Much Better（2005）把 Kapranos 干人声、McCarthy 碎节奏吉他、Hardy 旋律贝斯与 Thomson 紧 hi-hat 焊在一起。

Take Me Out（2004）故意拆开主副歌速度——舞池后朋而不走 prog 时长。与 Interpol、The Strokes 同在 2000 年代复兴地图，但更瞄准律动与迪斯科贝斯型，而非纽约 garage 酷感。

note.en: Verse at half tempo, chorus full sprint—dance-punk arrangement as hook.
note.zh: 主歌半速、副歌全速——dance-punk 编曲即钩子。

note.en: Staccato guitar stabs and four-on-the-floor kick for second-album radio.
note.zh: 断奏吉他刺击与四拍底鼓，服务二专电台。

note.en: Early Darts of Pleasure EP cut—wire-tight rhythm section before debut polish.
note.zh: 早期 Darts of Pleasure EP 曲——首专抛光前的绷紧节奏组。

title.zh: 格拉斯哥 dance-punk 上 indie 榜

body.en:
Franz Ferdinand matter as a UK post-punk revival export that actually moved bodies: short songs, dry production, rhythm guitar as lead voice.

Debut Franz Ferdinand (2004, Domino) landed during the Strokes/Interpol wave but pushed disco bass and tempo tricks.

Take Me Out’s half-time verse into full-speed chorus is the cited arrangement move.

Kapranos’s conversational vocal keeps the band readable on radio without losing art-school edge.
body.zh:
Franz Ferdinand 要紧处是英国后朋复兴出口里真能带动身体：短歌、干制作、节奏吉他当主声部。

首专 Franz Ferdinand（2004，Domino）落在 Strokes/Interpol 浪潮中，但推迪斯科贝斯与变速花招。

Take Me Out 半速主歌接全速副歌是被引用的编曲动作。

Kapranos 对话式人声让乐队在电台上可读而不丢艺术学校棱角。

body.en:
2002–2017 core: Kapranos, McCarthy, Hardy, Thomson—no second singer, dual guitar/key duties on McCarthy.

You Could Have It So Much Better (2005) keeps the same engine with bigger choruses; Do You Want To adds staccato riff stacking.

Right Thoughts, Right Words, Right Action (2013) later swaps some dance-punk for new-wave synth touches without changing the four names on stage.

McCarthy’s 2017 exit ends the defining visual and guitar voicing of the first decade.
body.zh:
2002–2017 核心：Kapranos、McCarthy、Hardy、Thomson——无双主唱，McCarthy 兼吉他与键盘。

You Could Have It So Much Better（2005）同一引擎、更大副歌；Do You Want To 加断奏 riff 堆叠。

Right Thoughts, Right Words, Right Action（2013）后期换部分 dance-punk 为新 wave 合成器点缀，台上四人名不变。

McCarthy 2017 年离队结束第一个十年的定义性外形与吉他声部。

title.en: Revival chart path to Arctic Monkeys
title.zh: 复兴榜路径至 Arctic Monkeys

body.en:
Franz Ferdinand’s 2004–05 chart run proved UK post-punk revival could sell beyond NYC—Talking Heads/Joy Division echoes with dance-floor tempo.

Later indie acts cite Take Me Out’s arrangement switch and Hardy’s melodic bass as entry points.

Arctic Monkeys’ early UK hype shares the same Domino/indie-chart infrastructure.

Influence is structural—tempo, bass, dry vocal—not costume revival.
body.zh:
Franz Ferdinand 2004–05 榜跑证明英国后朋复兴可卖过纽约——Talking Heads/Joy Division 回声加舞池速度。

后期 indie 引用 Take Me Out 编曲切换与 Hardy 旋律贝斯作入口。

Arctic Monkeys 早期英国炒作共享同一 Domino/indie 榜基建。

影响在结构——速度、贝斯、干人声——非戏服复兴。

interviewQuotes.text: We wanted songs girls could dance to—and boys could play.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Alex Kapranos

interviewQuotes.text: The angular riff is the hook. Everything else is arrangement.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Nick McCarthy

note.zh: McCarthy 时代；艺术学校舞曲朋克单曲。

note.en: Tempo drop mid-song as indie dance-floor citation.
note.zh: 曲中降速，indie 舞池引用点。

note.en: Post-punk revival with disco economy; Glasgow art-school precision.
note.zh: 带 disco 经济性的后朋克复兴；格拉斯哥艺术学校精度。
